# Synthetic Bing fixtures

By [Kieran Simkin](https://kieransimkin.co.uk/), part of [DanceFlow](https://kieransimkin.co.uk/danceflow/).

All names, figures, text, ranks and reports here are fabricated test data. They
are not current search results or statements about actual demand. JSON schemas
are KeywordMoves interchange formats, not claimed native Bing API formats.
Only `native-queries.json` models the documented WCF response structure.
`serp.html` is deliberately simple synthetic markup, not a verified Bing selector.
